_what_this_is: THE BACKLOG OF STRANDED SEAT EVIDENCE, as it stood when the fault was
repaired at source. A panel harvest lands under bench/logs/**, which
.gitignore ignores, so every seat-written file is invisible to git by
construction. 12 scripts and 2 design notes were rescued BY HAND on
2026-09-30; the founder's ruling on being shown it was recurring was
'clearly that also needs to be repaired'.
THE REPAIR is bench/panel_sandbox.py:preserve_seat_evidence, called from
harvest(), which copies every seat-written file with NO tracked
counterpart into experimental_notes/seat_evidence/<round>/<seat>/ with
provenance at source and the seat's own sha256 recorded before the header
is prepended. From now on a round preserves its own evidence.
THIS FILE IS THE RATCHET'S BASELINE, not an exemption. The guard at
bench/tests/test_seat_evidence_stranding_does_not_grow_2026-10-01.py
asserts that no round's count GROWS, and that any round not listed here
has ZERO stranded files -- because any round archived after the repair
should have preserved its own. Counts may only fall.
RULES FOR EDITING. Lower a count when files are genuinely rescued, and
delete the entry when it reaches 0. Never raise one, and never add a new
round: a new round with stranded evidence means the repair stopped
working, which is the thing this file exists to catch.
